label: Username and password authentication
type: authenticating by presenting a username and password, the default Server mechanism. Sits alongside auth-mechanism:x509-certificate as the two primary mechanisms.
note: Promoted as the baseline mechanism. Its documented default policy is notably weak - usernames-and-passwords.md 'demands only that the password have a minimum of six characters' - which the same page then recommends strengthening: a secure-by-configuration rather than secure-by-default posture, recorded twice in this batch (see also SCRAM-SHA1).
